description: Run *.test.lua files. Inside a test file use the global `ccunit`: test(name, fn [, {timeout}]), eq, neq, near, contains, truthy, raises(fn, pattern), skip, and run(program, {seconds|script, args}) / screen(monitor?) / touch(monitor, x, y) to drive a program and read its screens (craftos_help {topic:"ccunit"}). Each file runs in its own fresh computer; peripherals can be attached with "monitors". timeoutMs is per file and covers copying the workspace; a file that hangs keeps the tests it finished and names the one it was in. The reply gives each file its status, a count of passing tests (named too in runs of up to 50 tests), and every failing test with its error and line. The computer gets a copy of the workspace (without .git, node_modules, .runtime and what .gitignore ignores); for a big workspace give world.deploy to copy only some folders.

budgetMs.description: Real time for the whole call (default 10 min). When it runs out, running files stop keeping their finished tests, and notRun lists the rest.

blocksHigh.description: Monitor height in blocks (1 block = 5 chars at scale 1).

blocksWide.description: Monitor width in blocks (1 block = 7 chars at scale 1).

paths.description: Files or directories; empty runs every *.test.lua.

timeScale.description: Virtual clock speed. 10 makes sleep(), os.clock() and os.epoch() run 10x faster than real time, so slow scripts finish quickly. timeoutMs stays in real time.

world.description: The world around the computer (an object). Fields: addons, version, simProgram, craftosPcApis, motd, players, host, interacting, autoApprove, economyAvailable, holdInteraction, vhcctweaks, economyDelayTicks, gearPowerAvailable, identifyAvailable, internalErrors, vhccStore, linkLatency, computerId, kind, advanced, terminal, config, position, cobaltSpeed, label, deploy, peripherals, environment, entities, ap, mekanism, turtle, disks, blocks, fills, ground, items, gameRules, turtleConfig, spawnProtection, worldBorder, loadedChunks, unloadedChunks, nextDiskId, gameData, seed; e.g. {"peripherals":[{"name":"chest_0","type":"minecraft:chest","size":27}],"deploy":[{"from":"src"}]}. world.deploy picks which workspace folders or files go on the computer, and where ([{"from":"src","to":"lib"}]), instead of a copy of the whole workspace. Every field with its options: craftos_help {topic:"world"} (or the craftos://schema/world resource). Checked before boot: a wrong key or peripheral type comes back as an error with a suggestion.

worldFile.description: A saved world: a name in the worlds folder (e.g. "advanced-peripherals-demo") or a workspace path to a .json file (e.g. "door.world.json"). Fields in `world` override it.

name: craftos_test
